subject: Request: one-time bridge-rate & packaging restructure for pilot - VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@healthspan.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthspan.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot pricing ask — need one-time alignment to procurement band

Hi Kimberly / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile for search+chat. Procurement ran our numbers overnight; they're asking if we can do a one-time bridge rate and a small packaging tweak to get the pilot across the finish line.

Key asks from Healthspan procurement:
- 45% off list for first 3 months (pilot period) on hosted tokens (generation + embeddings)
- Add a temporary 1,000-seat support add-on at a deeply discounted flat fee for pilot operations
- Contract to include an onboarding SLA and a mechanism to convert to Dedicated within 90 days if ramp is above threshold

We understand this is aggressive — we have attached the procurement summary and their proposed contract redlines. Can you confirm if Redwood can accommodate a short-term concession and what approvals would be needed?

Olivia Barnes
Head of Partnerships, Healthspan.ai
olivia@healthspan.ai

Attachments: healthspan_pricing_request.pdf, contract_redlines_v1.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@healthspan.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing ask — need one-time alignment to procurement band

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the transparency and the materials. Short answer: possible but requires an internal exception. I'm looping Jordan (Commercial Lead) and Marcus (Finance) to run the impact model & approval path.

A couple of quick clarifying points that will speed this up:
- Is the 45% ask applied to list per-token pricing only, or should we treat the support add-on as part of the blended discount?
- Confirm the expected token volume for pilot months 1–3 (they mentioned heavy ingestion in month 2 in the deck).

Jordan / Marcus — we have an inbound pilot that needs a timebound concession. Olivia included proposed redlines. I want to understand the delta to our guardrails and whether we can offer a convert-to-Dedicated step without conceding baseline rate economics.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: FW: Pilot pricing ask — escalation request (VP/CFO signoff)

Kim / Marcus / Marissa —

Looping you in. Summary and my read:
- Healthspan is a credible prospect with strong upsell potential to Dedicated in 6–12 months.
- Their procurement wants an aggressive, one-off 45% off list for three months + a subsidized support seat bucket. That would exceed the standard pilot concession we give (typically 20–25% intro credits).
- They want contractual language allowing conversion to Dedicated within 90 days with pre-negotiated rates (this locks us into an option we should scope carefully).

Ask: we need a VP/CFO-level exception memo recommending either:
A) One-time pilot concession: 35% off list (instead of 45%) + $6k flat support fee for the pilot (capped), with conversion to Dedicated at standard tiered pricing; OR
B) Full 45% but only if Healthspan commits to a 6-month minimum or a $X minimum consumption guarantee (whichever occurs first).

Marcus — can you run a quick delta on projected revenue impact (best / expected / worst) and attach a P&L view. Marissa — can you draft a short exec memo with recommended option and rationale for VP/CFO signoff? We should attach Healthspan's revenue model and proposed clause language.

I put this as high priority — want to respond to Olivia tomorrow EOD.

-Jordan

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 11:05 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot pricing ask — exec memo for exception (draft)

Team — attaching the memo and the impact model. High level recommendation and rationale:

Recommendation (Option A, softened):
- Offer a 33% one-time pilot concession on hosted generation + embeddings for the initial 3-month pilot window (applies to token list rates only).
- Offer a $5,000 capped support add-on for the pilot (covers up to 1,000 support seats); any overage billed at standard support rate thereafter.
- Include a conditional conversion clause: Healthspan may convert to Dedicated within 90 days; conversion pricing will follow a pre-defined tier that is not lower than our standard Tier-2 list price (i.e., no pre-discounted lock-in). If conversion happens within 90 days, Redwood gets a 30% uplift for the first Dedicated month as a conversion fee.

Rationale:
- 33% keeps the economics within acceptable loss tolerance for a short period and improves our close rate versus the 20–25% standard pilot concession.
- $5k capped support protects margins while addressing Healthspan's ops concern.
- Conversion clause preserves our pricing power and limits future rate erosion.

Estimated financial impact (Marcus' model attached):
- Best case (conversion month 1 post-pilot + ramp to Dedicated): Net incremental ARR +$420k over 12 months.
- Base case (no conversion, pilot only): Net revenue loss vs. baseline: ~$18k; marketing/acquisition benefit expected.
- Worst case (pilot consumes low tokens and no conversion): Minimal direct loss, but small cost of support subsidy (~$5k).

Attachments included: impact_model.xlsx, exec_exception_memo_healthspan.docx, redlines_summary.txt

Request: Please sign off with VP/CFO authority or provide edits. I can tighten language on conversion protections if Finance requests. We need to reply to Healthspan by Thu EOD 11/12.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: impact_model.xlsx, exec_exception_memo_healthspan.docx, redlines_summary.txt

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pilot pricing ask — exec memo for exception (draft)

Thanks Marissa — good, pragmatic framing. Marcus: anything that materially changes the numbers in her summary? If not, I'll send the memo up to VP (Markus) and CFO for signoff and include the three attachments.

Also adding suggested redline language for the conversion clause below. If legal wants edits we can iterate.

--- suggested clause ---
If Customer elects to convert from Hosted to Dedicated within ninety (90) days following the Pilot End Date, Customer will be charged at Redwood's published Dedicated Tier-2 list price for the first billing month following conversion. Redwood will apply a single conversion uplift equal to thirty percent (30%) of such month’s charges to cover one-time capacity allocation and migration costs. All future Dedicated pricing will be governed by the then-current Redwood Dedicated rate card.

Kimberly
